title: External Evidence Host Result
description: Producer custody resolved by a package-trusted host signature and referenced opaquely by callers.

status.description: Host-declared currentness before expiry and revocation checks.

result_ref.description: Opaque reference presented by an external consumer.

audience.description: Audience bound by the host signature.

producer_id.description: Evidence producer identity resolved by the trusted host.

issuer_id.description: Issuer identity bound to the package-pinned host key.

transport_id.description: Non-authoritative transport identity kept separate from producer custody.

proof_route.description: Repository proof route the result claims to satisfy.

evidence_class.description: Repository evidence class for authority matching.

result.description: Producer result value interpreted by repository authority policy.

evidence_ref.description: Stable external reference retained instead of copying the evidence payload.

proof_subject_digest.description: Digest binding the host result to the submitted proof subject.

issued_at.description: UTC time when the trusted host issued the result.

expires_at.description: UTC time after which the result cannot be admitted.

nonce.description: Replay identity included in the signed payload.

revoked_at.description: Optional revocation time that makes the result unusable.

superseded_by.description: Optional replacement result reference that makes this result unusable.

host_admission.description: Package-trusted signature metadata for the complete host result.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded signature over every other host-result field.
